title: Preserve undelivered Engram context across compaction refreshes
outcome: Compaction invalidation or a new pending bit can replace a fetched but undelivered advancing-next page. Preserve queued and in-flight pages, defer refresh until delivery, cover current and deprecated Codex events, bound best-effort dedup. Implement in main; no new checkout. Parent coordination tm-rxhl.
acceptance: Undelivered and in-flight compaction regressions first fail then pass; both event routes preserve delivery; dedup bounded; cache reviewed before bootstrap composition.
